title.value: Understanding Web Application Workloads and Their Applications: Systematic Literature Review and Characterization
title.justification: The title is stated in the document header and describes the main focus of the paper: a systematic literature review and characterization of web application workloads.
title.quote: Understanding Web Application Workloads and Their Applications: Systematic Literature Review and Characterization

analysis.description: This paper conducts a systematic literature review to identify and analyze existing studies that leverage web application workloads. It characterizes these workloads in terms of daily and weekly patterns to offer insights for applications in software maintenance, workload prediction, and resource provisioning.

type.justification: The paper conducts a systematic literature review which involves gathering, analyzing, and synthesizing existing empirical studies on web application workloads.
type.quote: In this study, we first conduct a systematic literature review to identify and analyze existing studies leveraging web application workloads.
